exit.note: baseline + 3R hard target on the runner; causal online chooser over {1208 baseline, 2168} by R per minute-in-market (monthly refit, shadow book) selects 2168 in all 19 months starting from 2024 warm-up data

recommended_spec.entry_filter: none (no causal filter - online thresholds, pairs, LightGBM S3-only/pooled, shadow-equity, short-skip - improved sumR and smoothness together)
inputs_needed_live: k70 stop quantile of recent MAE
shadow-book R and exit time of both candidate exits per signal (optional, for the adaptive chooser)

in_sample_best_spec.label: IN-SAMPLE (best ret/DD with n>=100); neighbours 2329/2368/2328 give 49-54R, DD 2.8-3.4

key_findings: 3R hard target on the runner is the single strongest exit lever: 169->249 trades (mean hold 20h->8h; slot busy ~all the time), sumR 40.9->52.6, months+ 15->17/19, eq_R2 0.921->0.977, top5days 73%->28%, monthly Sharpe 0.55->0.88; maxDD 2.7->3.5
Baseline is concentrated: Jan-2026 = +16.4R of 40.9R; ex-Jan-2026 baseline +24.5R vs +42.3R with the 3R cap

H4 trail barely matters (identical results with h4q50/h4q80/none once capped); atr2 chandelier is ruinous (-4R over 1008 trades); k70 stop is the sweet spot (k50 = more R but DD 6.5-9.5, top5d 43-90%)
No regime-conditioned exit beat the unconditioned choice (14 regime features x 4 candidate sets x 2 objectives); unrestricted causal search over 3600 policies overfits (10-16/19 months, DD 8-12.5)

No causal entry filter helps: LightGBM IC 0.05-0.13 and filtered sumR 46-50 vs 52.6; online feature thresholds best = h1_adx top-20% skip (48.0R, 18/19 months, -4.6R); shadow-equity filters harmful (23-48R)

Losing/flat months = low D1/H4 volatility & expansion (d1_atr_rank -0.98 sd, h4_vr10 -0.73 sd, 9/9 bad months) and weak D1 trend (d1_ribbon -0.70 sd) while intraday M15/H1 momentum is strong: intraday trends in a quiet daily range that do not follow through
robustness_notes: Neighbours of 2168 (k90/2R 3128, k70/3R+q90k50, k70/3R+ts_half, k70/half@f30/3R) all give 15-17/19 months, eq_R2 0.97-0.98, top5d 26-29%
Causal result depends on the candidate set: chooser over {base,3R} gives 45.9-52.6R; allowing 1R/2R with a rate objective gives 38.3R (DD 6.9)
2026-07 is negative under every exit tested (-1.0 to -2.7R)
Higher-return but less smooth alternative: 2288 (no partial, be1, 3R) +84.1R, DD 5.8, ulcer 1.97, 15/19 months - picked by the causal mean-R chooser in every month
